The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime libraries beside Kino.exe (vcruntime140*.dll, msvcp140*.dll, concrt140.dll, and vccorlib140.dll) are Microsoft's redistributable files, copied unmodified from the Visual Studio installation that built Kino. Microsoft permits their distribution with applications under the Distributable Code terms of the Visual Studio license. Those terms ask for no notice in the application; this entry records where the files come from.
